title: Roblox Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 1.469 billion and infrastructure and trust-and-safety expense was USD 363 million.
summary: Roblox's Q2 Form 10-Q confirms the issuer's quarterly results, USD 6.084 billion of cash and investments, USD 1.009 billion of long-term debt, ongoing GAAP losses, rising platform costs and continuing safety, regulatory and dilution risks.
